caveats: All accept_ids require the stated field corrections and licensing/attribution retention before canonical integration. This review edits only its uniquely owned JSON review artifact; it does not merge shared ledgers or final CSV.

Original accessible sources were independently fetched as inert text: 33 command-bearing entries plus eight distinct source-grant URLs. Commands were compared/read statically; HTML rendering, CRLF/backslash continuations and source template rendering were inspected, never executed.

328 and 336 were reviewed against actual original command boundaries and their corrected raw excerpts. The reported broken extraction was not rerun. RST narrative/Output JSON are not accepted Bash data.

Every proposed dangerous row retains its corresponding real safe row and reciprocal edges from the packet. Only new baseline 031 reciprocal edge/status requires integration change. Listing is a separate safe inspection task, not a deletion simulation or approval.

AWS pairs assume unchanged ordinary AWS CLI account/profile/region configuration between alternatives; no pair introduces different explicit selectors. Source fixtures can show resource absence or already-deleted status; that does not invalidate read-only inventory or prove completeness.

Master usernames, resource identifiers, states and service endpoints may be returned; those are bounded metadata here, not password values, credentials retrieval, private database-row fixture contents or configuration-secret export. Ordinary trusted client configuration is assumed, not investigated or falsely certified.

Backup/snapshot deletions remain critical/ask under CAT-3.4 default because they irreversibly remove recovery data, without asserting sole-copy loss. Explicit final snapshot cases instead receive high with documented recovery rationale; cache-replica-capable deletion receives high separately.

Global dedup remains integration-owned. Within this packet, actual utility/service/selection/version/recursion semantics support diversity; resource renamings and formatting-only variants are not credited. Existing gsutil versus modern gcloud uses distinct utilities with documented different flags, not resource alias padding.

The seven dataset leads were reviewed as exclusions using collector evidence; this review does not claim a second full-corpus audit or reconfirm reported failures. Unknown/restricted terms never enter accepted set.

No dataset commands, database/cloud/storage clients, downloaded source code, tests, builds, linters, formatters or validators were executed. Only inert source retrieval/parsing and review-artifact writing occurred. No source code was edited; no-comments linter is inapplicable to JSON review data.
